title: Phase 10B durable PostgreSQL metadata, embeddings, and session persistence

recommendation.reason: Private document access, relational lifecycle, pgvector integrity, and revocable sessions cross security and data-integrity boundaries.

workers.scope: PostgreSQL document repository, follow-up migration, normalized reading/evidence/vector writes, and focused offline tests.
workers.outcome: Accepted after coordinator review and a live PostgreSQL correction for SQL NULL versus JSON null evidence geometry.

execution.coordinator_scope: Settings and application composition, durable JWT session store and logout route, integration tests, documentation, migration activation, and live isolated smoke verification.

passed: Focused offline pytest coverage for PostgreSQL records, sessions, configuration, authentication, and migration contracts.
Ruff and strict mypy for the backend.
Live Alembic upgrade 20260920_0001 to 20260920_0002 against local PostgreSQL/pgvector.
Live provider-free upload, OCR read, restart, pgvector persistence, MinIO content-only verification, session revocation, and cascading delete against local MinIO/PostgreSQL.
not_run: A PostgreSQL-native lexical/vector ranking query: existing bounded same-document ranking remains in the application service while vectors are now durable.
A live OpenAI provider request: the infrastructure smoke deliberately used a deterministic OCR substitute and no real licence.

limitations: Extraction and review snapshots are durable in documents.record_json; writing their separate normalized history tables is deferred.
The local environment remains a single-machine demonstration, not a production backup, malware-scanning, rate-limited, or multi-worker deployment.
